evidence.title: SDoH-Aware Narrative Anchoring Bias in Medical LLMs for Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support

summary: Researchers identify narrative anchoring bias in medical large language models, which may disproportionately influence clinical decision support based on social determinants of health. The findings underscore the need for fairness and trustworthiness in AI-driven healthcare tools.
title: Study Highlights Social Determinants of Health Bias in Medical AI Models
